text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance: \"I don't trust them\"","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states its argument directly and makes its stance easy to identify from the start."},{"evidence":"gives multiple reasons: \"virus and crash purposely\"; \"people could hack into them\"","quality":"supporting reasons","description":"The essay backs up its claim with more than one objection rather than relying on a single unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"asks \"if a driverless car gets out of hand how do we deal with it?\"","quality":"reasoned concern","description":"The essay raises a specific problem and frames it as a logical consequence of the technology."},{"evidence":"\"What I just talked about is the dangers...\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more recognizable argumentative structure with an introduction, development of reasons, and a closing restatement."},{"evidence":"\"people should rely more on themselves than on a car\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending returns to the main claim and gives a clear final takeaway."}]}
